claims.statement: A temporary access token is a string of three dot-delimited parts (header, payload, signature) whose header is the literal tk; its payload carries the token's metadata directly.

sources.supports: Each token is a string delimited by dots into three parts; the header is a literal value of either pk, sk or tk; tk tokens contain the contents of the metadata directly in the payload.

claims.statement: A temporary access token can carry an expiration up to one hour in the future.

sources.supports: The Tokens API creates temporary tk tokens, which can support an expiration parameter up to 1 hour in the future.

openQuestions.question: Candidate only: alphabet, signature and length are not yet researched for this family.
